plume_sources.name: Deonar Dumping Ground (132 Ha Solid Waste Landfill)
plume_sources.description: Mumbai's oldest & largest dumping ground; nocturnal land-breeze advects smoldering waste particulates directly over Shivaji Nagar (0.8 km WNW).

plume_sources.name: Trombay Thermal Power Station & RCF Petrochemical Complex
plume_sources.description: Heavy industrial stack & refinery corridor in Mahul/Trombay; impacts Chembur, Sewri, and Shivaji Nagar under SE/S winds.

plume_sources.name: Mumbai Port Trust (MbPT) & Sewri Mudflat Bunker Corridor
plume_sources.description: Heavy diesel truck staging & marine bunker emissions along Eastern Dockyard; primary contributor to Byculla & Sewri nocturnal PM2.5.

plume_sources.name: Kanjurmarg & Mulund Waste Processing Belt
plume_sources.description: Eastern creek waste transfer & bio-reactor zone along Thane Creek.

plume_sources.name: Malad Creek & New Link Road High-Density MahaRERA Cluster
plume_sources.description: 128 active high-rise redevelopment and metro corridor sites generating coarse & fine resuspended dust around Malad West.

plume_sources.name: Western Express Highway (Borivali–Dahisar Toll Bottleneck)
plume_sources.description: Heavy interstate freight & commuter bottleneck adjacent to Borivali East CAAQMS.
